stories.title: Token Revocation API and Enforcement
stories.description: Implement API endpoint(s) and backend logic to revoke bearer tokens, including immediate invalidation, status update in storage, and enforcement during authentication checks. Ensure revoked tokens cannot be reused and are logged for audit.

stories.title: Lifecycle Integration and End-to-End Tests
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering full token lifecycle: issuance, rotation, expiration, and revocation. Validate enforcement within GPTReader request flow and ensure audit logs capture all lifecycle events.
